Author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
Name: Gratis
Description: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
Changelog: Click quest markers to open the quest in the Quest Log; instance quests point at the entry NPC or door; separate map size/position in duties; Locate player toolbar button; enemy dots; fog of war removed (it grew memory after reloads); toolbar and settings polish.
